stem.text: A ball is projected into the air from horizontal ground and follows the path shown in the diagram.

stem.alt: Curved path of a ball above a horizontal ground line, with labelled points Q, R, S and T on the path. Vertical arrows show heights above the ground: 1.5 m at Q, 1.8 m at R, 1.6 m at S and 1.3 m at T. Labels: path of ball; horizontal ground; not to scale.

stem.text: At points Q, R, S and T, the ball has kinetic energies $E_\text{Q}$, $E_\text{R}$, $E_\text{S}$ and $E_\text{T}$ respectively. The heights above the ground of these four points are shown.
Which difference in kinetic energies is the smallest?
